w5-20_slippery_car.desc: AS 1743 W5-20 slippery symbol, as the sheet cites

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. W5-SA73 900 x 1200 (2015, 1:10), R100, 15 / 45 (edge 15 + border 30). Red band 200 high from 75 below the top (30 of yellow between the border and the band), full width inside the border: WARNING 120 D white, baseline 235, 684 (108/684/108). GRAVEL 244 + 45 + ROADS 208, 60 C, baseline 385 (201/…/202). Symbol W5-20 (slippery) 300 high from 45 below, 320 wide (290/320/290) — the national W5-20 symbol fitted to that box. SURFACE 290 + 45 + CONDITIONS 385, 60 C, baseline 835 (105 below the symbol; 90 margins); CHANGE 256 + 45 + OFTEN 195, 60 C, baseline 940 (202 margins). Lower red band 140 high ending 65 above the bottom (y 995-1135): DRIVE 222 + 65 + CAREFULLY 452, 90 B white, baseline 1110 (170 below; 80 / 81 margins). Approval required.
